coverage.description: check_ev2 rejects self/event-missing references, enforces same-world explicit placement, and validates about. check_value validates Mother/Father IDs as existing distinct characters. check_links folds latest snapshots and checks bidirectional character-location, object-holder, relation-endpoint, location-parent, plan/belief-owner and part/whole links in ordered entity traversal; missing target snapshots default empty. It does not validate arbitrary semantic facts or prove acyclicity. check_parts enforces the reverse PartOf pointer. Test-only inject bypasses gates. run_mode creates a fresh root world, attempts every Line, counts successful commands, records rejected Lines/errors, and marks all attempted anchors covered even when rejected; uncovered uses sentence indices cast to u16.
